描述_EN: a ‘bi’ is a flat circular slab of jade with a central hole. its function in prehistoric times remains unknown. however the ‘bi’ was made at least a thousand years before the ‘zhouli’ was written. an ancient chinese text entitled the ‘zhouli’ (‘rituals of zhou’) describes the ‘bi’ as a ceremonial object to sacrifice to heaven.
描述_ZN: "璧 "是一种扁平的圆形玉石板，中间有一个孔。 其在史前时代的功能仍然未知。 然而 "璧 "的制作时间至少比 "周礼 "的书写时间早一千年。 一篇名为《周礼》的中国古籍将 "璧 "描述为祭祀上天的礼器。
